events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday
angles.copy: Still bringing the attitude and the anthems. Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic second solo album, 'Imagine', released in the UK on this day in 1971, marks its 55th anniversary.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless anthem that still resonates today.

events.title: The first iPod was unveiled 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket', on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember when everyone had one of these? 25 years since Apple unveiled the game-changing iPod.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. Happy James Bond Day to all the 007 fans out there! What's your favourite Bond theme?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles legend John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music, his message, forever.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: No silly walks today, just celebrations! Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered their iconic 'White Album'. A double LP that still sounds revolutionary.

events.title: 35 years since we lost Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991, 35 years ago.

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Still the champion, my friends. 35 years today, the world lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice lives on.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history. 61 years since The Beatles gave us the incredible 'Rubber Soul'.

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who tragically passed away on this day in 1980, 46 years ago.

angles.name: Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Gone but never forgotten. Today marks 46 years since the world lost John Lennon, a true musical visionary.
